# Third-party notices for the P2.9 rule data

The data in this directory keep their third-party license terms. The project's PolyForm license applies to eligible original material.

| Rules | Origin and license |
| --- | --- |
| `meta-ads.list`, `meta-international.list` | Converted from the published MetaCubeX meta-rules-dat snapshot. GPL-3.0 applies to these rule adaptations. V2Fly provides domain data under MIT. The upstream build uses Loyalsoldier domain-list-custom under MIT. |
| `tif-mini.mrs` | Compiled from the published HaGeZi TIF Mini exact-domain list under GPL-3.0. |

Both GPL-3.0 data sources use the full text accompanying this release in [LICENSE](LICENSE). The two list adaptations were converted and deduplicated on 2026-11-18. The TIF MRS was compiled on the same date with exact-domain semantics preserved. [Sources, modifications and reproduction](SOURCE.md) · [Snapshot identifiers and checksums](SHA256.json)

Felix Yan's dnsmasq-china-list contributes domains to the upstream Google category under WTFPL-2.0. Copyright © 2015 Felix Yan. [Fixed source license](https://github.com/felixonmars/dnsmasq-china-list/blob/94f89bb5065cdff0777ef3a116ecfecb14ca1f56/LICENSE)
